title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Hosea 9: the threshing floor that will not feed them, the prophet called a fool, and the glory of Ephraim flying away.

questions.text: What does the chapter say Israel loves, at every grain threshing floor?
questions.explanation: The verse tells Israel not to rejoice, because they were unfaithful to their God and love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.

answers.text: The songs of the nations
The feasts of the new moon
The praise of their princes
The wages of a prostitute

questions.text: Where does this chapter say Ephraim will return, and where will they eat unclean food?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will not dwell in Yahweh's land, but Ephraim will return to Egypt and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.

answers.text: He will return to Gilgal and eat unclean food in Samaria
He will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria
He will return to the wilderness and eat unclean food in Moab
He will return to Bethel and eat unclean food in Gilead

questions.text: What are their sacrifices said to be like to them?
questions.explanation: The verse says their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners, and all who eat of it will be polluted.

answers.text: Like the bread of mourners
Like water poured on the ground
Like smoke that the wind drives away
Like a gift refused by a king

questions.text: Which city does this chapter say will bury them?
questions.explanation: The verse says Egypt will gather them up and Memphis will bury them, and that nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver.

answers.text: Samaria
Shechem
Memphis
Beth Arbel

questions.text: What does this chapter say Israel will consider the prophet to be?
questions.explanation: The verse says Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of their sins.

answers.text: A watchman, and the inspired man blind
A stranger, and the inspired man a beggar
A judge, and the inspired man a priest
A fool, and the inspired man insane

questions.text: What does this chapter say is on all the paths of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: The verse says a prophet watches over Ephraim with my God, that a fowler's snare is on all of his paths, and that there is hostility in the house of his God.

answers.text: A heap of stones
A fowler's snare
A thorn hedge
A pit of clay

questions.text: The deep corruption of the people is compared with the days of which place?
questions.explanation: The verse says they have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah, and that he will remember their iniquity and punish them for their sins.

answers.text: Gibeah
Gilgal
Baal Peor
Beth Aven

questions.text: How does Yahweh say he found Israel, and where did they then go?
questions.explanation: The verse says he found Israel like grapes in the wilderness, but they came to Baal Peor and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing.

answers.text: Like a vine in good soil, but they came to Beth Aven
Like a flock in a meadow, but they came to Gilgal
Like grapes in the wilderness, but they came to Baal Peor
Like a fig tree in a garden, but they came to Samaria

questions.text: What does this chapter say will happen to the glory of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: The verse says that as for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird, and that there will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.

answers.text: It will be carried off to Assyria
It will wither like grass on a roof
It will be given to a foreign king
It will fly away like a bird

questions.text: Why does the last verse say God will cast them away?
questions.explanation: The verse says his God will cast them away because they did not listen to him, and that they will be wanderers among the nations.

answers.text: Because they would not pay their vows
Because they did not listen to him
Because they had emptied his house
Because they had hired a foreign king
